production_jobs_note: status is the Ray job status; branch_status and design_status give the design outcome. finished is the export time per route (info.json); controller_finished_utc is the controller finish time.

failure_causes: Camera shielding constraint 0.29 (crash_front) forces frame material below the lens
maximum_extra_gap_mm 3.0 lets the frame drop below the camera
